localFormats.name: PESEL
localFormats.description: Universal Electronic System for Registration of the Population. 11-digit identifier containing date of birth, serial, gender, and checksum control digit.

localFormats.name: NIP
localFormats.description: Numer Identyfikacji Podatkowej. 10-digit tax identification number used by individuals and legal entities in Poland.

localFormats.name: REGON
localFormats.description: National Official Register of Business Entities. Supports 9-digit local registry numbers and 14-digit subdivision registration concepts.

localFormats.name: Polish IBAN
localFormats.description: Polish accounts use PL country prefix followed by a two-digit control checksum and 26-digit basic bank account numbers.

localFormats.name: BIC / SWIFT
localFormats.description: BIC/SWIFT codes identify financial institutions for Polish and international bank account transfers.

localFormats.name: EU VAT / VIES
localFormats.description: Polish VAT numbers prefix PL to the NIP string. EU VIES status checks represent a separate status query, not just local validation.
related: Polish VAT / EU VAT Syntax Workbench

localFormats.name: Polish postal code
localFormats.description: Five-digit code using NN-NNN pattern (e.g. 00-001 for main Warsaw). Broadly maps to postal zones and districts.

localFormats.name: Polish phone numbers
localFormats.description: Nine-digit national number length using country code +48 for mobile and regional landline prefixes.

localFormats.name: BLIK
localFormats.description: Six-digit mobile instant payment standard widely supported across Polish banking apps.

payments.title: PLN and Polish IBAN
payments.text: Poland uses PLN and participates in IBAN-based European banking flows. Domestic transfers use local clearing systems (Elixir).

payments.title: NRB domestic account
payments.text: Domestic Polish account numbers use a 26-digit NRB structure that maps cleanly into a PL-prefixed IBAN.

payments.title: SEPA
payments.text: SEPA credit transfers apply to Euro-denominated payments, but domestic flows mostly use PLN-native routing.

payments.title: Split payment / MPP
payments.text: Polish split payment workflows separate VAT amount, supplier NIP, invoice reference, and gross transfer amount.

payments.title: Payment QR payloads
payments.text: QR-like payment payloads are useful for transfer intent, amount, recipient account, and reference-field testing.

payments.title: Tax microaccount
payments.text: Tax microaccount calculations depend on PESEL or NIP input and must be treated as payment-routing support, not a bank lookup.

payments.title: BIC / SWIFT
payments.text: BIC/SWIFT details are required for international SWIFT transfers and cross-border bank account payments.

payments.title: BLIK
payments.text: BLIK uses short-lived six-digit consumer codes. The workbench validates shape and safe fixture behavior without pretending to verify live codes.

payments.title: Card payments
payments.text: Debit and credit card flows follow global card network schemas plus Polish locale amount formatting conventions.

payments.title: PLN amount and grosz
payments.text: Polish money tools normalize comma decimals, grosz integer values, VAT rates, and copyable developer payloads.

commonMistakes: Treating BLIK as a bank account identifier rather than a mobile payment token.
Using comma instead of space for thousands formatting, which looks unnatural to Polish users.
Forgetting the hyphen in the NN-NNN postal code display.
Hardcoding PLN symbol position before the amount (PLN should be formatted as 123,45 zł or 123,45 PLN).
Conflating 26-digit domestic NRB accounts with 28-character PL IBANs in databases.

highlights: Poland uses pl-PL locale for formatting.
PLN is displayed with space separators and 'zł' symbol at the end (e.g. 1 234,56 zł).
Diacritics like ł and ż are common and must be preserved.
BLIK is the leading mobile payment method in Poland.
developerNotes: Ensure database tables support UTF-8 for Polish diacritics.
Validate local PESEL, NIP, and REGON formats separately.
Use PL country prefix for IBAN validation on Polish accounts.
